# bioexcel/biobb_vs/fpocket_select

## Summary

Selects a single pocket in the outputs of the fpocket building block.

Selects a single pocket in the outputs of the fpocket building block from a given parameter.

Nextflow adapter of the [FPocketSelect](https://biobb-vs.readthedocs.io/en/latest/fpocket.html#module-fpocket.fpocket_select) building block of [biobb_vs](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_vs) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_VS_FPOCKET_SELECT } from 'bioexcel/biobb_vs/fpocket_select'

workflow {
    BIOBB_VS_FPOCKET_SELECT(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_pockets_zip` | yes | zip | Path to the pockets found by fpocket |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pocket_pdb` | yes | pdb | Path to the PDB file with the cavity found by fpocket |
| `output_pocket_pqr` | yes | pqr | Path to the PQR file with the pocket found by fpocket |
| `versions_biobb_vs` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_vs', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of FPocketSelect properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_pocket_pdb: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_vs container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_VS_FPOCKET_SELECT' {
        ext.properties = [pocket: 1]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pocket` | integer | 1 | Pocket id from the summary json given by the fpocket building block. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
